info.title: SerpApi Universal API
info.description: SerpApi provides structured search engine results and related search APIs across Google, Bing, Amazon, YouTube, and other supported engines.

get.description: Retrieves Google autocomplete suggestions from SerpApi.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

relevance.description: Provider relevance score for the suggestion.

serpapiLink.description: SerpApi follow-up link for the suggestion.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The Google search query to run through SerpApi.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Search origin location, ideally at city level.

schema.description: Search origin location, ideally at city level.

parameters.name: google_domain
parameters.description: Google domain to use, such as google.com.

schema.description: Google domain to use, such as google.com.

parameters.name: gl
parameters.description: Two-letter country code for Google country targeting.

schema.description: Two-letter country code for Google country targeting.

parameters.name: hl
parameters.description: Two-letter Google interface language code.

parameters.name: no_cache
parameters.description: Set true to force a fresh SerpApi request instead of reusing cache.
